title: Inter's greatest derby win ever? The 2024 Scudetto derby vs the 5–1 — we picked
caption: Inter's greatest derby win of all time? Milan 1–2 Inter, April 22, 2024: Acerbi and Thuram, the 20th Scudetto sealed in the derby itself with five games to spare — a sixth straight derby win. Inter 5–1 Milan, September 16, 2023: Mkhitaryan twice, Thuram, Çalhanoğlu and Frattesi, four scorers and a four-goal margin. Also in the running: the 6–5 of 1949, Mourinho's 4–0 in 2009, the 4–2 comeback of 2020 and the Champions League semi-final of 2023. We picked.
